ar: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ لِيَكُونَ لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ نَذِيرًا
fr: Béni soit Celui qui a fait descendre le Livre du Discernement sur Son serviteur, afin qu’il soit un avertisseur à l’Univers.
en: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His Servant that he may be to the worlds a warner -
tr: Tabaraka allathee nazzalaalfurqana AAala AAabdihi liyakoona lilAAalameenanatheera

ar: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٌ فِى ٱلْمُلْكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ تَقْدِيرًا
fr: Celui à qui appartient la royauté des cieux et de la terre, qui ne S’est point attribué d’enfant, qui n’a point d’associé en Sa royauté et qui a créé toute chose en lui donnant ses justes proportions.
en: He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and who has not taken a son and has not had a partner in dominion and has created each thing and determined it with [precise] determination.
tr: Allathee lahu mulku assamawatiwal-ardi walam yattakhith waladan walamyakun lahu shareekun fee almulki wakhalaqa kulla shay-infaqaddarahu taqdeera

ar: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً لَّا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ مَوْتًا وَلَا حَيَوٰةً وَلَا نُشُورًا
fr: Mais ils ont adopté en dehors de Lui des divinités qui, étant elles-mêmes créées, ne créent rien, et qui ne possèdent la faculté de faire ni le mal ni le bien pour elles-mêmes, et qui ne sont maîtresses ni de la mort, ni de la vie, ni de la résurrection.
en: But they have taken besides Him gods which create nothing, while they are created, and possess not for themselves any harm or benefit and possess not [power to cause] death or life or resurrection.
tr: Wattakhathoo min doonihi alihatanla yakhluqoona shay-an wahum yukhlaqoona walayamlikoona li-anfusihim darran wala nafAAan walayamlikoona mawtan wala hayatan walanushoora

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ وَأَعَانَهُۥ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ ءَاخَرُونَ ۖ فَقَدْ جَآءُو ظُلْمًا وَزُورًا
fr: Les mécréants disent : "Tout ceci n’est qu’un mensonge qu’il (Mohammed) a inventé, et où d’autres gens l’ont aidé." Or, ils commettent là une injustice et un mensonge.
en: And those who disbelieve say, "This [Qur’ān] is not except a falsehood he invented, and another people assisted him in it." But they have committed an injustice and a lie.
tr: Waqala allatheena kafaroo in hathailla ifkun iftarahu waaAAanahu AAalayhiqawmun akharoona faqad jaoo thulmanwazoora

ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ٱكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِىَ تُمْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
fr: Et ils disent : "Ce sont des contes d’anciens qu’il se fait écrire ! On les lui dicte matin et soir !"
en: And they say, "Legends of the former peoples which he has written down, and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon."
tr: Waqaloo asateeru al-awwaleenaiktatabaha fahiya tumla AAalayhi bukratan waaseela

ar: قُلْ أَنزَلَهُ ٱلَّذِى يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
fr: Dis : "L’a fait descendre Celui qui connaît les secrets dans les cieux et la Terre. Et Il est Pardonneur et Miséricordieux.
en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed by He who knows [every] secret within the heavens and the earth. Indeed, He is ever Forgiving and Merciful."
tr: Qul anzalahu allathee yaAAlamu assirrafee assamawati wal-ardiinnahu kana ghafooran raheema

ar: وَقَالُوا۟ مَالِ هَـٰذَا ٱلرَّسُولِ يَأْكُلُ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِى فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ ۙ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُۥ نَذِيرًا
fr: Et ils disent : "Qu’est-ce donc que ce Messager qui mange de la nourriture et circule dans les marchés ? Que n’a-t-on fait descendre vers lui un Ange qui eût été avertisseur en sa compagnie ?
en: And they say, "What is this messenger that eats food and walks in the markets? Why was there not sent down to him an angel so he would be with him a warner?
tr: Waqaloo mali hatha arrasooliya/kulu attaAAama wayamshee fee al-aswaqilawla onzila ilayhi malakun fayakoona maAAahu natheera

ar: أَوْ يُلْقَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُۥ جَنَّةٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُورًا
fr: Ou que ne lui a-t-on lancé un trésor ? Ou que n’a-t-il un jardin à lui, dont il pourrait manger (les fruits) ?" Et les injustes disent : "Vous ne suivez qu’un homme ensorcelé !"
en: Or [why is not] a treasure presented to him [from heaven], or does he [not] have a garden from which he eats?" And the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."
tr: Aw yulqa ilayhi kanzun aw takoonu lahujannatun ya/kulu minha waqala aththalimoonain tattabiAAoona illa rajulan mashoora

ar: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا۟ لَكَ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ فَضَلُّوا۟ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا
fr: Vois à quoi ils te comparent! Ils se sont égarés et ils ne peuvent trouver aucun chemin.
en: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
tr: Onthur kayfa daraboolaka al-amthala fadalloo fala yastateeAAoonasabeela

ar: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِن شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِّن ذَٰلِكَ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ وَيَجْعَل لَّكَ قُصُورًۢا
fr: Béni soit Celui qui, s’Il le veut, t’accordera bien mieux que cela : des jardins sous lesquels coulent les ruisseaux; et Il t’assignera des châteaux.
en: Blessed is He who, if He willed, could have made for you [something] better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow - and could make for you palaces.
tr: Tabaraka allathee in shaajaAAala laka khayran min thalika jannatin tajreemin tahtiha al-anharu wayajAAal laka qusoora

ar: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا
fr: Plutôt, ils ont qualifié l’Heure de mensonge. Et Nous avons préparé, pour quiconque qualifie l’Heure de mensonge, une Flamme brûlante.
en: But they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze.
tr: Bal kaththaboo bissaAAatiwaaAAtadna liman kaththaba bissaAAatisaAAeera

ar: إِذَا رَأَتْهُم مِّن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَزَفِيرًا
fr: Lorsque de loin elle les voit, ils entendront sa fureur et ses crépitements.
en: When it [i.e., the Hellfire] sees them from a distant place, they will hear its fury and roaring.
tr: Itha raat-hum min makaninbaAAeedin samiAAoo laha taghayyuthanwazafeera

ar: وَإِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُّقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْا۟ هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورًا
fr: Et quand on les y aura jetés, dans un étroit réduit, les mains liées derrière le cou, ils souhaiteront alors leur destruction complète .
en: And when they are thrown into a narrow place therein bound in chains, they will cry out thereupon for destruction.
tr: Wa-itha olqoo minha makanandayyiqan muqarraneena daAAaw hunalika thuboora

ar: لَّا تَدْعُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ثُبُورًا وَٰحِدًا وَٱدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا كَثِيرًا
fr: "Aujourd’hui, ne souhaitez pas la destruction une seule fois, mais souhaitez-en plusieurs !"
en: [They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction."
tr: La tadAAoo alyawma thubooran wahidanwadAAoo thubooran katheera

ar: قُلْ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ ٱلْخُلْدِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ۚ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَآءً وَمَصِيرًا
fr: Dis : "Est-ce mieux ceci ? Ou bien le Paradis éternel qui a été promis aux pieux, comme récompense et destination dernière ?
en: Say, "Is that better or the Garden of Eternity which is promised to the righteous? It will be for them a reward and destination.
tr: Qul athalika khayrun am jannatualkhuldi allatee wuAAida almuttaqoona kanat lahum jazaanwamaseera

ar: لَّهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ خَـٰلِدِينَ ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَّسْـُٔولًا
fr: Ils auront là tout ce qu’ils désireront et une demeure éternelle. C’est une promesse incombant à ton Seigneur.
en: For them therein is whatever they wish, [while] abiding eternally. It is ever upon your Lord a promise [worthy to be] requested.
tr: Lahum feeha ma yashaoonakhalideena kana AAala rabbika waAAdanmas-oola

ar: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَأَنتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِى هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ أَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوا۟ ٱلسَّبِيلَ
fr: Et le jour où Il les rassemblera, eux et ceux qu’ils adoraient en dehors d’Allah, Il dira : "Est-ce vous qui avez égaré Mes serviteurs que voici, ou ont-ils eux- mêmes perdu le sentier ?"
en: And [mention] the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides Allāh and will say, "Did you mislead these, My servants, or did they [themselves] stray from the way?"
tr: Wayawma yahshuruhum wamayaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi fayaqoolu aantum adlaltumAAibadee haola-i am hum dalloo assabeel

ar: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۢبَغِى لَنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ مِن دُونِكَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَـٰكِن مَّتَّعْتَهُمْ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَسُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بُورًا
fr: Ils diront : “Gloire à Toi ! Il ne nous convenait nullement de prendre en dehors de Toi des patrons protecteurs mais Tu les as comblés de jouissance ainsi que leurs ancêtres au point qu’ils en ont oublié le [livre du] Rappel [le Coran]. Et ils ont été des gens anéantis.”
en: They will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for us to take besides You any allies [i.e., protectors]. But You provided comforts for them and their fathers until they forgot the message and became a people ruined."
tr: Qaloo subhanaka ma kanayanbaghee lana an nattakhitha min doonika min awliyaawalakin mattaAAtahum waabaahum hattanasoo aththikra wakanoo qawman boora

ar: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًا وَلَا نَصْرًا ۚ وَمَن يَظْلِم مِّنكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيرًا
fr: "Ils vous ont démentis en ce que vous dites. Il n’y aura pour vous ni échappatoire ni secours (possible). Et quiconque des vôtres est injuste, Nous lui ferons goûter un grand châtiment."
en: So they will deny you, [disbelievers], in what you say, and you cannot avert [punishment] or [find] help. And whoever commits injustice among you - We will make him taste a great punishment.
tr: Faqad kaththabookum bimataqooloona fama tastateeAAoona sarfan walanasran waman yathlim minkum nuthiqhuAAathaban kabeera

ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ ۗ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًا
fr: Et Nous n’avons envoyé avant toi que des Envoyés qui mangeaient de la nourriture et circulaient dans les marchés. Et Nous avons fait de certains d’entre vous une épreuve pour les autres - endurerez-vous avec constance ? - Et ton Seigneur demeure Clairvoyant.
en: And We did not send before you, [O Muḥammad], any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you [people] as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing.
tr: Wama arsalna qablaka minaalmursaleena illa innahum laya/kuloona attaAAamawayamshoona fee al-aswaqi wajaAAalna baAAdakumlibaAAdin fitnatan atasbiroona wakanarabbuka baseera

ar: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَا ۗ لَقَدِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْ عُتُوًّا كَبِيرًا
fr: Et ceux qui n’espèrent pas Nous rencontrer disent : "Si seulement on avait fait descendre sur nous des Anges ou si nous pouvions voir notre Seigneur !" En effet, ils se sont enflés d’orgueil en eux-mêmes, et ont dépassé les limites de l’arrogance.
en: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or [why] do we [not] see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves and [become] insolent with great insolence.
tr: Waqala allatheena layarjoona liqaana lawla onzila AAalaynaalmala-ikatu aw nara rabbana laqadiistakbaroo fee anfusihim waAAataw AAutuwwan kabeera

ar: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
fr: Le jour où ils verront les Anges, ce ne sera pas une bonne nouvelle, ce jour-là, pour les injustes, ils (les Anges) diront : "Barrage totalement défendu !"
en: The day they see the angels - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."
tr: Yawma yarawna almala-ikata labushra yawma-ithin lilmujrimeena wayaqooloona hijranmahjoora

ar: وَقَدِمْنَآ إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ هَبَآءً مَّنثُورًا
fr: Nous avons considéré l’œuvre qu’ils ont accomplie et Nous l’avons réduite en poussière éparpillée.
en: And We will approach [i.e., regard] what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.
tr: Waqadimna ila maAAamiloo min AAamalin fajaAAalnahu habaan manthoora

ar: أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُّسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا
fr: Les gens du Paradis auront, ce jour-là, une meilleure demeure et un plus beau lieu de repos.
en: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place.
tr: As-habu aljannati yawma-ithinkhayrun mustaqarran waahsanu maqeela

ar: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِٱلْغَمَـٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا
fr: Et le jour où le ciel sera fendu par les nuages et qu’on fera descendre successivement les Anges.
en: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.
tr: Wayawma tashaqqaqu assamao bilghamamiwanuzzila almala-ikatu tanzeela

ar: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَسِيرًا
fr: Ce jour-là, la vraie royauté appartiendra au Tout Miséricordieux, et ce sera un jour difficile pour les infidèles.
en: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.
tr: Almulku yawma-ithin alhaqqu lirrahmaniwakana yawman AAala alkafireena AAaseera

ar: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ ٱلظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى ٱتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًا
fr: Le jour où l’injuste se mordra les deux mains et dira : "Hélas pour moi ! Si seulement j’avais suivi chemin avec le Messager !
en: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.
tr: Wayawma yaAAaddu aththalimuAAala yadayhi yaqoolu ya laytanee ittakhathtumaAAa arrasooli sabeela

ar: يَـٰوَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِى لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًا
fr: Malheur à moi ! Hélas ! Si seulement je n’avais pas pris "un tel" pour ami !
en: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one as a friend.
tr: Ya waylata laytanee lamattakhith fulanan khaleela

ar: لَّقَدْ أَضَلَّنِى عَنِ ٱلذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَنِى ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ خَذُولًا
fr: Il m’a, en effet, égaré loin du Rappel [le Coran], après qu’il me soit parvenu." Et le Diable (Satan) déserte l’homme (après l’avoir tenté).
en: He led me away from the remembrance after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."
tr: Laqad adallanee AAani aththikribaAAda ith jaanee wakana ashshaytanulil-insani khathoola

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مَهْجُورًا
fr: Et le Messager a dit : “Ô Seigneur ! Mon peuple a vraiment pris ce Coran pour une chose délaissée ! ”
en: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur’ān as [a thing] abandoned."
tr: Waqala arrasoolu yarabbi inna qawmee ittakhathoo hatha alqur-anamahjoora

ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّا مِّنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَنَصِيرًا
fr: Et c’est ainsi que Nous fîmes à chaque Prophète un ennemi parmi les criminels. Mais ton Seigneur suffit comme guide et comme secoureur.
en: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper.
tr: Wakathalika jaAAalna likullinabiyyin AAaduwwan mina almujrimeena wakafa birabbika hadiyanwanaseera

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةً وَٰحِدَةً ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَـٰهُ تَرْتِيلًا
fr: Et ceux qui ne croient pas disent : "Pourquoi n’a-t-on pas fait descendre sur lui le Coran en une seule fois ?" Nous l’avons révélé ainsi pour raffermir ton cœur. Et Nous l’avons récité soigneusement[ 656].
en: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur’ān not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.
tr: Waqala allatheena kafaroo lawlanuzzila AAalayhi alqur-anu jumlatan wahidatan kathalikalinuthabbita bihi fu-adaka warattalnahu tarteela

ar: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا
fr: Et ils ne t’apporteront aucune parabole, sans que Nous ne t’apportions la vérité avec la meilleure interprétation.
en: And they do not come to you with an example [i.e., argument] except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation.
tr: Wala ya/toonaka bimathalin illaji/naka bilhaqqi waahsana tafseera

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
fr: Ceux qui seront traînés [ensemble] sur leurs visages vers l’Enfer, ceux-là seront dans la pire des situations et les plus égarés hors du chemin droit.
en: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.
tr: Allatheena yuhsharoona AAalawujoohihim ila jahannama ola-ika sharrun makananwaadallu sabeela

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًا
fr: En effet, Nous avons donné à Moïse le Livre et lui avons assigné son frère Aaron comme assistant.
en: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant.
tr: Walaqad atayna moosaalkitaba wajaAAalna maAAahu akhahu haroonawazeera

ar: فَقُلْنَا ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَـٰهُمْ تَدْمِيرًا
fr: Puis Nous avons dit : "Allez tous deux vers les gens qui ont traité de mensonge Nos preuves !" Nous les avons alors détruits complètement.
en: And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction.
tr: Faqulna ithhaba ilaalqawmi allatheena kaththaboo bi-ayatinafadammarnahum tadmeera

ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا۟ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةً ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
fr: Et le peuple de Noé, quand ils eurent démenti les Messagers, Nous les noyâmes et en fîmes pour les gens un signe d’avertissement. Et Nous avons préparé pour les injustes un châtiment douloureux.
en: And the people of Noah - when they denied the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.
tr: Waqawma noohin lamma kaththabooarrusula aghraqnahum wajaAAalnahum linnasiayatan waaAAtadna liththalimeenaAAathaban aleema

ar: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَأَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًۢا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرًا
fr: Et les 'Âd, les Thamûd, les gens d’Ar-Rass et de nombreuses générations intermédiaires !
en: And [We destroyed] ʿAad and Thamūd and the companions of the well and many generations between them.
tr: WaAAadan wathamooda waas-habaarrassi waquroonan bayna thalika katheera

ar: وَكُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ ۖ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًا
fr: À tous, Nous avions proposé des paraboles et Nous les avons tous anéantis d’une façon brutale.
en: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.
tr: Wakullan darabna lahu al-amthalawakullan tabbarna tatbeera

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَى ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۚ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَرَوْنَهَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًا
fr: Et ils sont passés par la cité sur laquelle est tombée une pluie de malheurs. Ne la voient-ils donc pas ? Plutôt, ils n’espèrent pas de résurrection !
en: And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil [i.e., stones]. So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection.
tr: Walaqad ataw AAala alqaryati allateeomtirat matara assaw-i afalam yakoonooyarawnaha bal kanoo la yarjoona nushoora

ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولًا
fr: Et quand ils te voient, ils ne te prennent qu’en raillerie : "Est-ce là celui qu’Allah a envoyé comme Messager ?
en: And when they see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allāh has sent as a messenger?
tr: Wa-itha raawka in yattakhithoonakailla huzuwan ahatha allathee baAAatha Allahurasoola

ar: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوْلَآ أَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
fr: Peu s’en est fallu qu’il ne nous égare de nos divinités, si ce n’était notre attachement patient à elles !" Cependant, ils sauront quand ils verront le châtiment, qui est le plus égaré en son chemin.
en: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.
tr: In kada layudillunaAAan alihatina lawla an sabarnaAAalayha wasawfa yaAAlamoona heena yarawna alAAathabaman adallu sabeela

ar: أَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَـٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا
fr: Ne vois-tu pas celui qui a fait de sa passion sa divinité ? Est-ce à toi d’être un garant pour lui ?
en: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?
tr: Araayta mani ittakhatha ilahahuhawahu afaanta takoonu AAalayhi wakeela

ar: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ ۚ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ ۖ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
fr: Ou bien penses-tu que la plupart d’entre eux entendent ou raisonnent ? En vérité, ils ne sont comparables qu’à des bestiaux. Ou plutôt, ils sont plus égarés encore du sentier.
en: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock. Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.
tr: Am tahsabu anna aktharahumyasmaAAoona aw yaAAqiloona in hum illa kal-anAAamibal hum adallu sabeela

ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنًا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا ٱلشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًا
fr: N’as-tu pas vu comment ton Seigneur étend l’ombre ? S’Il avait voulu, certes, Il l’aurait faite immobile. Puis, Nous lui fîmes du soleil son indice,
en: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.
tr: Alam tara ila rabbika kayfa madda aththillawalaw shaa lajaAAalahu sakinan thumma jaAAalnaashshamsa AAalayhi daleela

ar: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًا يَسِيرًا
fr: puis, Nous la saisissons [pour la ramener] vers Nous avec facilité.
en: Then We [retract and] hold it with Us for a brief grasp.
tr: Thumma qabadnahu ilaynaqabdan yaseera

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا وَٱلنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورًا
fr: Et c’est Lui qui vous fit de la nuit un vêtement, du sommeil un repos et qui fit du jour un retour à la vie active.
en: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.
tr: Wahuwa allathee jaAAala lakumuallayla libasan wannawma subatan wajaAAalaannahara nushoora

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً طَهُورًا
fr: Et c’est Lui qui envoya les vents comme une annonce précédant Sa miséricorde . Et Nous fîmes descendre du ciel une eau pure et purifiante,
en: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy [i.e., rainfall], and We send down from the sky pure water
tr: Wahuwa allathee arsala arriyahabushran bayna yaday rahmatihi waanzalna mina assama-imaan tahoora

ar: لِّنُحْـِۧىَ بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا وَنُسْقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا وَأَنَاسِىَّ كَثِيرًا
fr: pour faire revivre par elle une contrée morte, et donner à boire aux multiples bestiaux et hommes que Nous avons créés.
en: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.
tr: Linuhyiya bihi baldatan maytanwanusqiyahu mimma khalaqna anAAaman waanasiyyakatheera

ar: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَـٰهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا
fr: Et Nous l’avons répartie entre eux afin qu’ils se rappellent (de Nous). Mais la plupart des gens se refusent à tout sauf à être ingrats.
en: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded, but most of the people refuse except disbelief.
tr: Walaqad sarrafnahu baynahumliyaththakkaroo faaba aktharu annasiilla kufoora

ar: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَّذِيرًا
fr: Or, si Nous l'avions voulu, Nous aurions certes envoyé dans chaque cité un avertisseur.
en: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.
tr: Walaw shi/na labaAAathna feekulli qaryatin natheera

ar: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَجَـٰهِدْهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادًا كَبِيرًا
fr: N’obéis donc pas aux infidèles ; et avec ceci (le Coran), lutte contre eux vigoureusement.
en: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with it [i.e., the Qur’ān] a great striving.
tr: Fala tutiAAi alkafireenawajahidhum bihi jihadan kabeera

ar: ۞ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَحِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
fr: Et c’est Lui qui fait confluer les deux mers: l’une douce, rafraîchissante, l’autre salée, amère. Et Il assigne entre les deux une zone intermédiaire et un barrage infranchissable.
en: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas [i.e., bodies of water], one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.
tr: Wahuwa allathee maraja albahraynihatha AAathbun furatun wahatha milhunojajun wajaAAala baynahuma barzakhan wahijranmahjoora

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبًا وَصِهْرًا ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًا
fr: Et c’est Lui qui de l’eau a créé une espèce humaine qu’Il a unie par les liens de la parenté et de l’alliance. Et ton Seigneur est Omnipotent.
en: And it is He who has created from water [i.e., semen] a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].
tr: Wahuwa allathee khalaqa mina alma-ibasharan fajaAAalahu nasaban wasihran wakanarabbuka qadeera

ar: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرًا
fr: Mais ils adorent en dehors d’Allah, ce qui ne leur profite point, ni ne leur nuit ! Et l’infidèle sera toujours l’allié des ennemis de son Seigneur !
en: But they worship rather than Allāh that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].
tr: WayaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi mala yanfaAAuhum wala yadurruhum wakanaalkafiru AAala rabbihi thaheera

ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
fr: Or, Nous ne t’avons envoyé que comme annonciateur et avertisseur.
en: And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
tr: Wama arsalnaka illamubashshiran wanatheera

ar: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
fr: Dis : "Je ne vous en demande aucun salaire (pour moi-même). Toutefois, celui qui veut suivre un chemin conduisant vers son Seigneur [est libre de dépenser dans la voie d’Allah]."
en: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."
tr: Qul ma as-alukum AAalayhi min ajrinilla man shaa an yattakhitha ilarabbihi sabeela

ar: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْحَىِّ ٱلَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
fr: Et place ta confiance en le Vivant qui ne meurt jamais. Et par Sa louange, glorifie-Le. Et il suffit comme Parfait Informé des péchés de Ses serviteurs.
en: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allāh] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, [fully] Aware -
tr: Watawakkal AAala alhayyi allatheela yamootu wasabbih bihamdihi wakafabihi bithunoobi AAibadihi khabeera

ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَسْـَٔلْ بِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
fr: C’est Lui qui, en six jours, a créé les cieux, la Terre et tout ce qui existe entre eux deux, et le Tout Miséricordieux S’est établi (Istawâ) ensuite sur le Trône. Interroge donc sur Lui un spécialiste en la matière.
en: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)].
tr: Allathee khalaqa assamawatiwal-arda wama baynahuma fee sittatiayyamin thumma istawa AAala alAAarshi arrahmanufas-al bihi khabeera

ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ قَالُوا۟ وَمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًا ۩
fr: Et quand on leur dit : "Prosternez-vous devant le Tout Miséricordieux !" Ils disent : "Qu’est-ce donc que le Tout Miséricordieux ? Allons-nous nous prosterner devant ce que tu nous commandes ?" - Et cela accroît leur répulsion .
en: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion.
tr: Wa-itha qeela lahumu osjudoo lirrahmaniqaloo wama arrahmanu anasjudulima ta/muruna wazadahum nufoora

ar: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجًا وَقَمَرًا مُّنِيرًا
fr: Que soit béni Celui qui a placé au ciel des constellations et y a placé un luminaire (le soleil) et aussi une lune éclairante !
en: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.
tr: Tabaraka allathee jaAAala feeassama-i buroojan wajaAAala feeha sirajanwaqamaran muneera

ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًا
fr: Et c’est Lui qui a assigné une alternance à la nuit et au jour pour quiconque veut se souvenir ou montrer sa reconnaissance.
en: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.
tr: Wahuwa allathee jaAAala allayla wannaharakhilfatan liman arada an yaththakkara aw aradashukoora

ar: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلْجَـٰهِلُونَ قَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا
fr: Les serviteurs du Tout Miséricordieux sont ceux qui marchent humblement sur Terre, et qui, lorsque les ignorants s’adressent à eux, disent : "Paix (Salâm) " ;
en: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
tr: WaAAibadu arrahmaniallatheena yamshoona AAala al-ardi hawnanwa-itha khatabahumu aljahiloona qaloosalama

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَقِيَـٰمًا
fr: et ceux qui passent les nuits prosternés et debout devant leur Seigneur;
en: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
tr: Wallatheena yabeetoonalirabbihim sujjadan waqiyama

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
fr: et ceux qui disent : “Notre Seigneur! Écarte de nous le châtiment de l’Enfer !” Certes, son châtiment est permanent.
en: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
tr: Wallatheena yaqooloona rabbanaisrif AAanna AAathaba jahannama inna AAathabahakana gharama

ar: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
fr: Quel mauvais gîte et lieu de séjour !
en: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
tr: Innaha saat mustaqarran wamuqama

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا۟ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًا
fr: Et ceux qui, lorsqu’ils dépensent, ne sont ni prodigues ni avares mais se tiennent au juste milieu.
en: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
tr: Wallatheena ithaanfaqoo lam yusrifoo walam yaqturoo wakana bayna thalikaqawama

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًا
fr: Et ceux qui n’invoquent pas d’autre dieu avec Allah et ne tuent pas la vie qu’Allah a rendue sacrée, sauf de bon droit ; et qui ne commettent pas de fornication, car quiconque fait cela encourra une punition.
en: And those who do not invoke with Allāh another deity or kill the soul which Allāh has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.
tr: Wallatheena layadAAoona maAAa Allahi ilahan akharawala yaqtuloona annafsa allatee harrama Allahuilla bilhaqqi wala yaznoona wamanyafAAal thalika yalqa athama

ar: يُضَـٰعَفْ لَهُ ٱلْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا
fr: Le châtiment lui sera doublé, au Jour de la Résurrection, et il y demeurera éternellement couvert d’ignominie ;
en: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -
tr: YudaAAaf lahu alAAathabu yawmaalqiyamati wayakhlud feehi muhana

ar: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَـٰتٍ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
fr: sauf celui qui se repent, croit et accomplit une bonne œuvre, alors ceux-là Allah changera leurs mauvaises actions en bonnes, et Allah est Pardonneur et Miséricordieux ;
en: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allāh will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Illa man taba waamanawaAAamila AAamalan salihan faola-ikayubaddilu Allahu sayyi-atihim hasanatinwakana Allahu ghafooran raheema

ar: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابًا
fr: et quiconque se repent et accomplit une bonne œuvre, alors c’est vers Allah qu’aboutira son retour.
en: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allāh with [accepted] repentance.
tr: Waman taba waAAamila salihanfa-innahu yatoobu ila Allahi mataba

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِٱللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا۟ كِرَامًا
fr: Et ceux qui ne portent pas de faux témoignages ; et qui, lorsqu’ils passent auprès d’une frivolité, s’en écartent noblement ;
en: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.
tr: Wallatheena layashhadoona azzoora wa-itha marroo billaghwimarroo kirama

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا۟ عَلَيْهَا صُمًّا وَعُمْيَانًا
fr: et ceux qui lorsque les versets de leur Seigneur leur sont rappelés, ne deviennent ni sourds ni aveugles ;
en: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
tr: Wallatheena itha thukkiroobi-ayati rabbihim lam yakhirroo AAalayha summanwaAAumyana

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
fr: et ceux qui disent : “Notre Seigneur! Donne-nous, en nos épouses et nos descendants, la joie des yeux, et fais de nous un guide pour les pieux !”
en: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous."
tr: Wallatheena yaqooloona rabbanahab lana min azwajina wathurriyyatinaqurrata aAAyunin wajAAalna lilmuttaqeena imama

ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ ٱلْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَـٰمًا
fr: Ceux-là auront pour récompense un lieu élevé [du Paradis] pour prix de leur endurance, et ils y seront accueillis avec le salut et la paix,
en: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace,
tr: Ola-ika yujzawna alghurfata bimasabaroo wayulaqqawna feeha tahiyyatan wasalama

ar: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
fr: pour y demeurer éternellement. Quel beau gîte et lieu de séjour !
en: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.
tr: Khalideena feeha hasunatmustaqarran wamuqama

ar: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا۟ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا
fr: “Mon Seigneur ne se soucie pas de vous si ce n’est votre prière. En effet, vous avez démenti (le Prophète). Votre [châtiment] sera donc inévitable et permanent. ”
en: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so it [i.e., your denial] is going to be adherent.
tr: Qul ma yaAAbao bikum rabbee lawladuAAaokum faqad kaththabtum fasawfa yakoonu lizama
